sentences.quote: Young-Way Liu (born 1956) is a Taiwanese business executive who serves as the chairman and president of Foxconn (Hon Hai Precision Industry). He was appointed to the position in 2019
sentences.text: Young Liu (Liu Young-Way), born in Taiwan in 1956, has been chairman and president of Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) since 2019, succeeding founder Terry Gou.

He earned a bachelor's degree in electrophysics from National Chiao Tung University in 1978 and a master's in computer engineering from the University of Southern California in 1986, and founded three companies: Young Micro Systems (1988), ITE Tech (1995) and ITeX (1997).

sentences.quote: Mr. Liu joined Foxconn in 2007 as Special Assistant to the Founder. In 2010, he was appointed as General Manager of the Innovation Digital System Business Group of Foxconn and later became the Chairman of Socle Technology Corp in 2014.
sentences.text: He joined Foxconn in 2007 as special assistant to the founder, led its Innovation Digital System group, chaired Socle Technology from 2014, set up its Semiconductor Business Group in 2016, and became chairman and CEO in 2019.
